title: RNA Quantitation
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol reformats RNA into a 96-well plate per a .csv input. Up to 96 tubes can be reformatted, and fresh tips are granted between each tube. Volume, source slot, source well, destination slot and destination well are all information that is taken from the csv to perform the protocol. Note: the csv format is NOT the same for [Part 2](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/7ada78-pt2). For csv information and formatting notes, see below. Explanation of complex parameters below: * `.CSV File`: Here, you should upload a .csv file formatted in the following way, being sure to include the header line (use slot 7 for the thermocycler slot, and input an "x" for values that are not needed in that row): If using a kingfisher plate, the multi-channel pipette will be used. For destination well, include only wells in the first row (A1, A2, A3,.., A12). The protocol will then proceed to perform full column transfers of the volume specified, for all columns specified (feel free to skip columns). * `Pipette Mount`: Specify which mount (left or right) to host the P20 single and multi-channel pipettes, respectively. ---

steps.title: Prepare CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a .csv file that includes a header line and the following columns for each sample: source slot, source well, destination slot, destination well, and volume (1‑20 µL). Use slot 7 for the thermocycler slot and enter an "x" for any fields that are not needed in a given row. List only destination wells in the first row of the 96‑well plate (A1, A2 … A12). If a Kingfisher plate is used, the protocol will employ the multi‑channel pipette for full‑column transfers. You may omit columns you do not wish to transfer.

steps.title: Load pipettes
steps.instruction: Attach the P20 single‑channel pipette to the mount (left or right) specified for single‑channel use, and attach the P20 multi‑channel pipette to the opposite mount as defined in the "Pipette Mount" parameter.

steps.title: Transfer samples
steps.instruction: For each row in the CSV (up to 96 rows), use the single‑channel pipette to aspirate the indicated volume (1‑20 µL) from the source tube (source slot and well) and dispense it into the corresponding destination well of the 96‑well plate (destination slot and well). Use a fresh tip for each tube.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the specified volume from the source tube.
Dispense the volume into the destination well.

steps.title: Repeat for all samples
steps.instruction: Continue the transfer step for every entry in the CSV until all samples (maximum 96) have been moved, performing full‑column transfers as indicated and skipping any columns not listed.
